title: Nine Arches of Stone
subtitle: 桥梁与建筑 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 桥梁与建筑（文学艺术与体育·建筑艺术）
meta: 主题语境：桥梁与建筑（文学艺术与体育·建筑艺术）　|　核心词汇：bridge　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bridge 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1944 my mother was sent to paint ① a bridge she could not cross, and she said the crossing was the whole of the lesson. The ② bridge, meaning the span and not the river, was nine arches long and was drawn by whoever came last; a bridge, she said, is the only thing in an album that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ bridge in that album had the same stone, and the ④ bridge at the north, meaning the one the engineer drew and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever painted properly. A bridge, my grandmother said, is nine parts stone and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the stone is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bridge was the whole of the town, meaning the town it joined and not the span. The ⑥ bridge, meaning the town and not any of that, is the only thing in a valley that everybody crosses and nobody questions; a bridge, he said, is either something you paint or the only word that means both a span and a town. She said the town is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ bridge had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the stone. The ⑧ bridge of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine arches and eleven years of crossing; a bridge, she said, is either the one at the north or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ bridge I remember is the one at the north, which was repaired in 1969 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ bridge, my grandmother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being crossed; every bridge, she said, is a town that has agreed to look like a span. She said the town was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 桥（指那座桥本身，与河相对）
C. 固定搭配：paint a bridge 画一座桥
D. n. 桥（指画册里每一座）
E. n. 桥（指北面那一座）
F. n. 桥（抽象：它连接起来的那个镇子）
G. n. 那个镇子（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bridge she could not cross
The bridge, meaning the span and not the river
bridge was the whole of the town
the bridge had become a photograph in a report
The bridge of the whole thing
A bridge, my grandmother said in 1977

answers.why: paint a bridge 意为“画一座桥”，1944 年母亲被派去画一座她过不去的桥。
bridge 意为“桥”，指那座桥本身而不是河，有九个拱，由最后走的人画下来。
bridge 指画册里每一座桥，每一座都是同样的石头。
bridge 指北面那一座（工程师画的那座），是唯一有人认真画过的。
bridge 意为“桥”，抽象指它连接起来的那个镇子，父亲说 bridge 就是那个镇子的全部。
bridge 为抽象用法，指那个镇子本身，是山谷里人人都过、却没人质疑的东西。
bridge 意为“桥、桥梁”，到 1962 年这座 bridge 成了报告里的一张照片。
bridge 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个拱和十一年的穿行。
bridge 意为“桥”，我记得的是北面那一座，1969 年修过，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
bridge 为抽象总称，祖母说桥是唯一会因为被人走过而变好的东西。
